interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
interpretation.rationale: The focal passage establishes that Harriet Doyle, the Head of Finance & People Ops, approves discounts that come to her, but she also mentions that Diane sometimes okays urgent ones herself and tells Harriet after. This suggests that there is an informal workaround for discount approval, which is not in line with the policy. However, Harriet does not explicitly state that the policy requires Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval for discounts above 15%. Therefore, the focal passage qualifies the original claim by indicating that there may be exceptions to the policy.

citations.locator: heading:INT-03 — Interview: Harriet Doyle > Discussion notes#block:001
citations.quotation: On discount approval: *"I approve what comes to me. I know Diane sometimes okays urgent ones herself and tells me after — that's not really how the policy reads, but I get why it happens. I'll be straight with you, I don't have full visibility into how often it happens versus how often it's reported to me."*
